title: Crude Membrane Protein Extraction from Tissues
author: Vivian Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.djt4nm

steps.title: Thaw tissue in high‑salt buffer
steps.instruction: Thaw 20–50 mg of tissue or a 15 cm dish of cells in 1 mL high‑salt buffer (2 M NaCl, 10 mM HEPES‑NaOH, pH 7.4, 1 mM EDTA); store the buffer at 4 °C.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the thawed tissue using an IKA Ultra Turbax blender at maximum speed (≈25,000 rpm) for 30 seconds.

steps.title: First ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Ultracentrifuge the homogenate in a Beckman MLA‑130 rotor at 100,000 g for 10 minutes; balance tubes so the weight difference is <50 mg.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in carbonate buffer
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL carbonate buffer (1 M Na2CO3, 1 mM EDTA, pH 11.3); store the buffer at 4 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with mixing
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension for 30 minutes with gentle mixing.

steps.title: Collect non‑soluble material
steps.instruction: Centrifuge as in step 3 to collect the non‑soluble material. If the integral membrane proteins represent <30–40 % of total identified proteins, repeat steps 4–6 two to three times.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 100,000 g for 10 min (as in step 3).
If membrane protein content <30–40 %, repeat steps 4–6 2–3 times.

steps.title: Wash pellet in urea buffer
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in wash buffer (4 M urea, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM HEPES‑NaOH, pH 7.4, 1 mM EDTA).

steps.title: Final membrane collection
steps.instruction: Collect the crude membranes by centrifugation as in step 3 (100,000 g, 10 min).
